description: List your YourImageShare uploads, newest first, 50 per page - use this to find an upload's `id` (needed by `delete_upload`) when you only have its URL or remember it by content, since there's no lookup-by-URL endpoint. Each result includes the same three link fields `upload_image` returns, plus `title` and `created_at`. An out-of-range page number returns an empty `data` array, not an error.
name: list_uploads

direct.description: The shareable page URL (title, description, comments, share buttons). Despite the field name, this is NOT a direct file link - use `src` for that.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 auto-delete timestamp, or null if the upload never expires.

id.description: Unique identifier for this upload. Pass to delete_upload to remove it.

path.description: Raw storage URL - the literal file, e.g. i.yourimageshare.com/xxx.webp.

src.description: Direct/embeddable file URL - use this for /

title.description: User-set title, or null if never set.

total.description: Total uploads across all pages, not just this one.

title: List your uploads
